fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on proposals to divide Florida and criticisms of Tallahassee-centered governance; questions and satire about law enforcement, prohibition raids, and gambling; discussion of railroad rate reductions and their effects; local real-estate conditions including foreclosure and contract-cancellation suits; community charity appeals (Community Chest and a rummage sale to support the Day Nursery); sports coverage and notices including University of Miami stadium ambitions and boxing at Pompano; and local business notices, advertisements, and legal notices (including mortgage foreclosure proceedings).
